title: Create groups, stations and a unit with deliberate crew positions
summary: Create an organizational parent, a Station group, a Support unit type and a two-position unit; verify saved relationships, inspect unchanged staffing, and find the unit through the group tree.
prerequisites: Use a fictional practice department and existing authorized group/unit/type permissions.
Prepare unique training names and an illustrative coordinate pair; preserve all current members and unit crews.
Have the intended personnel role available for the unit position; do not change actual staffing in this exercise.

scene_practices.title: Inspect groups and their hierarchy
scene_practices.practice: Identify the existing parent relationships before adding your own fictional group.

scene_practices.title: Prepare an organizational parent
scene_practices.practice: Prepare an empty organizational root with a unique training name and Parent None.

scene_practices.title: Save and reopen the empty group
scene_practices.practice: Reopen the saved root and check its type, parent and empty membership.

scene_practices.title: Prepare a station under the new parent
scene_practices.practice: Prepare a Station group with your own organizational group as its parent.

scene_practices.title: Enter a complete illustrative coordinate pair
scene_practices.practice: Save the complete fictional pair with no membership or provider setup changes.

scene_practices.title: Verify the saved station and relationship
scene_practices.practice: Compare the catalog relationship with the station’s reopened name, parent and coordinates.

scene_practices.title: Separate a unit definition from its crew
scene_practices.practice: Identify the type, station and seat-definition controls before creating the unit.

scene_practices.title: Create a useful unit type
scene_practices.practice: Prepare an own Support type with Standard Actions and the built-in Van icon.

scene_practices.title: Save the built-in icon and verify the type
scene_practices.practice: Verify the saved type’s full name, class, actions and built-in icon.

scene_practices.title: Define two distinct positions
scene_practices.practice: Prepare the two seat definitions and compare their personnel-role conditions.

scene_practices.title: Inspect a template without applying it
scene_practices.practice: Inspect and close a template, leaving the two prepared positions unchanged.

scene_practices.title: Save the unit and reopen its definition
scene_practices.practice: Reopen the saved unit and verify its full station selection and both seat definitions.

scene_practices.title: Inspect staffing without changing assignments
scene_practices.practice: Read the new unit’s empty seats and existing crew, then leave without saving staffing.

scene_practices.title: Find the unit through its parent and station
scene_practices.practice: Find the saved unit through both its parent group and its station.

scene_practices.title: Apply the structure across sectors
scene_practices.practice: Sketch a fictional parent, station, type and unit suited to your sector before changing real configuration.

sector_examples.Chicago Fire: Separate coordination groups, stations and response vehicles; verify definitions before staffing.
sector_examples.Community care and mental health: Organize operational teams/bases without patient detail or clinical authorization claims.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Distinguish coordination, staging bases and resources.
sector_examples.Security: Inspect patrol templates and choose deliberate local positions rather than applying them blindly.
sector_examples.Wildland: Separate seasonal coordination groups, bases and resource types.
sector_examples.Industrial response: Distinguish facility groups from response vehicles and their seat requirements.
